definition: TP = a real agenda item, ordinance text, or staff/public record about the topic in the land-use / siting sense, and the matched text belongs to that matter. Text in an adopted zoning resolution or ordinance attached to a packet as reference (or in the unchanged part of a whole-resolution redline) is FP even when the packet also carries a real amendment: the amendment is caught by the staff report or agenda line, not by the attachment. General (non-zoning) ordinance amendments, non-land-use moratoria, utility-rate items and permit fee tables count as FP. tags_ok = every topic tag on the hit is right for the matched text.
